plain_description.what: An engineering check. It asks whether merging four code files that add LiveCodeBench support changes any output byte of a small AG_NEWS tree build, by comparing the build before and after the change.
plain_description.why: New code must not silently change existing trees before it is merged.
plain_description.information: Identical outputs would clear the merge. Differences would block it, unless they come from run-to-run randomness. Result: done. The check failed as registered: 2 of 21 files differed, in three quality metrics. A repeat of the old code alone showed the same differences, so the cause is non-determinism in those metrics, not the change. The 19 other identical files are descriptive only, the merge was not done, and the question moved to a follow-up test.
